highlights: Buttercream specialist, selling cakes professionally since 2016
Featured in PEOPLE in 2025 for her own wedding cakes

goodToKnow.text: Orders are placed by sending a message on Instagram to @lucy_jane_cakes, as the business's TikTok bio directs.
Some designs use cake boards and toppers from outside suppliers, which are credited in the video captions.

faqs.q: How do we order a cake?
faqs.a: By sending a message on Instagram. The TikTok bio says 'Message on Instagram for orders' and links to the @lucy_jane_cakes Instagram account.

faqs.q: Where is Lucy Jane Cakes based?
faqs.a: The TikTok bio gives the location as London.
Photo cakes are among the designs she shows. She has posted a how-to video on making one, naming the piping nozzles she used.

serviceDetails.name: Heart cakes
serviceDetails.more: The 'ALL THE PINKS' video was posted in September 2024 and credits the cake board to @OLBAA as well as the toppers to @LissieLou.

serviceDetails.name: Themed and character cakes
serviceDetails.more: Other themed designs on her TikTok include a 'Rainbows and unicorns' cake posted in September 2023 and tagged #cakepiping and #cakedecorating.

notes: Very little public information exists. Fetched on 27 Oct 2026: the TikTok profile (bio 'Lucy Jane Cakes / London / Message on Instagram for orders'; about 193.6K followers, 513 videos), seven cited TikTok video captions and the PEOPLE/AOL article. There is no website, and Instagram is not viewable without logging in, so no price list, flavour menu, lead times, deposit terms, delivery or collection arrangements, serving sizes or dietary and allergen options could be verified, and no booking process is described beyond messaging on Instagram (so howItWorks is empty). The flavours named in the PEOPLE article (vanilla lemon, vanilla raspberry, vanilla jam, chocolate hazelnut, plain chocolate and chocolate Nutella, plus a classic vanilla main cake) were for her own wedding, so they were not presented as an order menu. The event types she caters for are not stated, and wedding cakes for clients are not confirmed. The supplier discount codes in her captions were not included.
